items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Include badged review findings in the ledger**

When the Codex Bot emits a top-level `review` body containing a P0–P3 badge, this comprehension ignores it because it accepts only `review_comment` items, so `orch-audit.sh` can report a complete ledger and start the audit while the acceptance record lacks that swept finding. This conflicts with the existing `swept_finding_ids()` contract in `scripts/require-crit-review.py`, which explicitly includes badged review bodies; reuse equivalent filtering here.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L72-L72](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/63433cf11438647e519f5382f4667182bcd70572/AGENTS.md#L72-L72)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Count Markdown-bulleted audit findings**

When an audit formats a finding as a normal Markdown list item such as `- [P1] ...`, this regex counts zero findings, allowing the pre-audit ledger check to pass without the corresponding `audit:<sha7>:<n>` row. The integration gate's `AUDIT_FINDING` regex deliberately accepts optional bullets and whitespace, so this checker must recognize the same audit syntax to enforce the ledger before the next audit.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L72-L72](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/63433cf11438647e519f5382f4667182bcd70572/AGENTS.md#L72-L72)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Require exact allowed-path coverage in C4**

When a row mentions only a longer path such as `scripts/foo.py.bak`, an allowed entry `scripts/foo.py` is treated as covered because C4 performs an unrestricted substring search over all controls and dispositions. Since the updated SKILL delegates the path half to C4/C7b, this false match can let a trust-boundary file reach dispatch without its required per-entry threat row; match path tokens in the row's control instead of arbitrary substrings.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/63433cf11438647e519f5382f4667182bcd70572/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bind the checker row to tests that close the whole control**

This `closed` row covers the entire task-consistency checker (C1–C10 and C7b), but its selected historical-fixture test exercises only C2/C3/C4/C6/C7; C1, C5, C7b, C8, C9, and C10 are reached only by separate tests. The declared selector therefore does not close the row as written; split the control or cite a test that covers the complete checker behavior.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/63433cf11438647e519f5382f4667182bcd70572/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)
